title: Adam Store – Full E-Commerce Platform
description: A complete e-commerce platform featuring customer storefront, admin dashboard, and backend API system for product, order, and user management.
details: Developed the entire Adam Store e-commerce system including both customer-facing and admin dashboards. The customer side provides product browsing, cart management, and order placement with secure authentication and responsive UI. The admin dashboard enables full control over inventory, orders, users, and analytics. The backend was built using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB with RESTful APIs and Axios integration for smooth data communication. The platform ensures scalability, performance, and an intuitive management experience for store operators.

title: Verana Blockchain Crawler & Indexing System
description: A high-performance blockchain data crawler and indexer with PostgreSQL storage and RESTful API exposure.
details: Developed a distributed blockchain crawler and indexer system for Verana Network that parses blockchain data and stores it efficiently in PostgreSQL. Built scalable background workers using Bull.js and service-based architecture with Moleculer.js. Designed RESTful APIs for external data access and implemented CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment using Docker. The system ensures reliability, scalability, and optimized data synchronization across blockchain nodes.

title: MagicCraft – NFT & Blockchain Gaming Platform
description: UI enhancement and feature integration for MagicCraft’s blockchain-based NFT gaming platform, focusing on NFT rentals, marketplace interactions, and gameplay economy systems.
details: Contributed to the MagicCraft blockchain gaming platform by improving the front-end UI/UX using Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Enhanced NFT marketplace pages, rental features, and real-time gameplay dashboards. Worked on Web3 integrations with wallet connectivity, NFT metadata handling, and Polymarket-based transaction logic for digital assets. Focused on seamless player experience and optimized loading performance across the platform.

title: HandenPols – Healthcare Service Platform
description: A modern healthcare service platform built using Next.js and Tailwind CSS for HandenPols, focused on therapy, rehabilitation, and patient engagement through a clean, accessible, and responsive design.
details: Developed a sleek and responsive healthcare website for HandenPols using Next.js and Tailwind CSS. The project emphasizes accessibility, high performance, and a seamless user journey for therapy and rehabilitation services. Built with modular components, optimized SEO, and mobile-first responsiveness to ensure a professional, trustworthy online presence.

title: Solanity Grid – Energy & Gas Dashboard
description: A real-time data dashboard for gas, oil and weather conditions, designed for operational monitoring and analytics.
details: Developed the Solanity Grid portal to visualize dynamic data in the energy sector, including gas, oil and weather metrics. The system loads data via secure RESTful APIs and displays interactive charts, tables and mapping components. Built with React and TypeScript for performance, and styled via Tailwind CSS for a modern, responsive layout.

title: Truvest Capital Market Website
description: Finance-platform website providing access to fintech banking products and trade-finance services, built with a React frontend.
details: Developed the frontend for Truvest Capital Market GmbH, a financial services platform offering trade finance, private advisory, and fintech banking products. Built using Create-React-App for a fast and modern user interface, with responsive design and seamless user experience across devices. The site integrates with backend portals and banking APIs for user on-boarding and secure service delivery. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

title: RizzDate - App Landing Page
description: A high-converting landing page for the RizzDate mobile app, built to highlight its voice-first dating experience with smooth animations and a modern design.
details: Developed a visually engaging landing page for RizzDate, a voice-first dating app. The site was built using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, with Framer Motion for fluid animations and smooth section transitions. It focuses on storytelling through clean UI, responsive layouts, and SEO optimization to enhance discoverability. The design communicates the app’s key features — voice matching, real-time chat, and video calls — while maintaining a modern, emotionally resonant aesthetic consistent with the app’s branding.

title: EPA Onboarding Portal
description: A bilingual onboarding portal for the Dubai government built with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
details: Developed a responsive bilingual onboarding website for the Dubai government using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Implemented dual language support (English and Arabic) with a smooth toggle system. Focused on accessibility, professional layout, and compliance with government design standards for a clean and user-friendly interface.

title: Liddy Silver Interiors
description: A refined interior design showcase website featuring smooth transitions and elegant layouts for a premium design studio.
details: Developed a visually engaging portfolio website for Liddy Silver Interiors using React and Swiper.js to display interactive project slides. Implemented dynamic background color transitions for immersive user experience. Focused on a minimal, editorial aesthetic with smooth animations and responsive layouts to highlight luxury interior design projects.

title: LivingWall Landing Page
description: A modern and lightweight company landing page showcasing LivingWall’s sustainable design services with smooth animations and fast loading speed.
details: Developed a clean and elegant landing page for LivingWall using React with Vite for optimized performance. Bootstrap components were customized with CSS transforms and transitions to achieve subtle animations. The layout is fully responsive and optimized for cross-device compatibility.

title: PyMC Labs
description: Agency website for Bayesian modeling experts providing AI and probabilistic consulting services.
details: Developed a professional agency website for PyMC Labs, featuring service showcases, AI and probabilistic consulting details, and a blog publishing system powered by Strapi CMS. Integrated a dynamic CRM backend and SEO-friendly architecture using Next.js with Tailwind CSS.

title: Devencodes – Software Company Portfolio
description: A sleek, high-performance company portfolio showcasing software solutions and creative expertise.
details: Built a modern and responsive company portfolio for Devencodes using Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Integrated Framer Motion for dynamic animations and smooth transitions, while leveraging ShadCN UI and Aeternity UI for polished interface components. Designed for speed, accessibility, and brand presence with a professional dark theme aesthetic.

title: DotGod Medical Dashboard
description: Comprehensive healthcare data management dashboard with dynamic REST API integration.
details: DotGod is a full-stack healthcare data management platform designed to centralize and manage patient and medical record data. The dashboard dynamically fetches and displays data from RESTful APIs, featuring secure authentication, role-based access, and group-based data insertion from uploaded files. Built with a scalable MERN architecture, the system offers real-time updates, advanced analytics, and a sleek, responsive UI.

title: Pest Insights Dashboard
description: Data-driven operational dashboard for pest-control services, delivering insights from scheduling, technician routing, and business KPIs in real time.
details: Frontend: React.js is used to create a fast, dynamic dashboard UI with data-driven charts and smooth admin interactions. Backend: Express.js handles company creation, Google Sheets data parsing, and provides API endpoints for metrics retrieval. Database: MongoDB stores company profiles, imported campaign metrics, and computed insights for quick retrieval. Data Sync: Google Sheets API integration ensures smooth imports and synchronization with external spreadsheets.

title: Kype.io
description: KYPI is a campaign performance tracking dashboard built for a client who previously relied on manual workflows to manage and analyze marketing data.
details: KYPI is a campaign performance tracking dashboard built for a client who previously relied on manual workflows to manage and analyze marketing data. Designed with simplicity and speed in mind, KYPI enables the admin to create new companies with a single click and import campaign performance data directly from a shared Google Sheet. The platform processes this data and displays it using interactive charts and metric summaries, eliminating repetitive manual tracking. Built using React, Express, and MongoDB, KYPI provides real-time insights with minimal input.

title: UniLabs - AI-Powered DeFi Asset Management
description: UniLabs represents a bold step forward in crypto investing—bringing AI, automation, and DeFi together in one powerful platform.
details: UniLabs is the first AI-powered decentralized finance (DeFi) asset management platform designed to democratize access to advanced crypto investment strategies. It leverages AI models, predictive analytics, and decentralized technologies to help users identify and invest in high-growth crypto projects. With features like smart contract auditing, automated portfolio balancing, and real-time market analysis, UniLabs offers a structured, data-driven approach to building generational wealth in the Web3 economy.

title: Senzi
description: Full MERN stack e-commerce platform with real-time features.
details: Senzi is a full-featured dropshipping platform designed specifically for the Libyan market. It empowers users to browse and import products directly from Chinese e-commerce giants 1688 and Taobao. The platform offers both an admin and user panel for streamlined operations. Built using modern technologies such as Next.js, Express, MongoDB, and React-Bootstrap, Senzi provides a seamless experience for store owners and individual resellers looking to source products globally.
